title: Why even Andrej Karpathy feels behind with AI! #ai #futureofwork
cleaned_content: Nate Jones discusses the pervasive feeling of being overwhelmed by AI's rapid advancements, even among experts like Andrej Karpathy. The video underscores the industry's accelerating pace, implying that continuous learning and adaptation are critical for staying current. This highlights the psychological impact of the AI paradigm shift on professionals.
